g.text: V4.1-Flash on B200 x4: resource-demand theory versus runtime evidence
Left: 3 fresh services. Middle: 3 fixed-token blocks in ONE additional service; not 3 fresh services. Observed min-max, not confidence intervals.
HBM request to 3402 MHz was NOT applied (actual 3996 MHz): no valid HBM-bandwidth intervention. Lower SM affects Tensor/CUDA cores and other paths.
Profiles: 8 decode steps/rank; duration sums can overlap and include profiling overhead. Synthetic probes only; no PD or ASIC conclusions.
